g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Rural Sindh households spend about Rs 4,500 a year on a typical student; one in
Source: PSLM 2019-20, person and household files. Sample: 1,440 students (ed_total > 0) in rural Sindh; 1 outside Rs
100-1,000,000 excluded. Weighted by hhweight; bins 0.1 wide in log10.
